commit.message:
Tick 69: audit the simulation/K14 message claim by claim; record five corrections

Records a blind verify-then-challenge audit of the relayed K14 message. None of its facts is an
informative anomaly: 196 = 91+14+91 is an identity, the 12/0/12 colour split and the diagonal
reading ' ?' are forced by the spiral encoding, 33/58 is the English median under the certified
board, and 1344 = 14 x 96 and 96 - 91 = 5 are typical under look-elsewhere nulls. The two 91-streams
are one design decision, since YOUWON can be planted at exactly one offset, 21.

Corrects tick 63's txids (364de511/722fbf35 were right) and the Gavin transaction's outputs (seven
of eight stamp addresses), tick 68's scalar count (52) and its dead edge-connectivity test, and
tick 67's stride-8 wording. Also fixes the tx file header and the YOUWON note's null rate, and
notes campaign 44's extra dependencies in the README.

commit.message:
Tick 71: affine-nonce trapdoor test on the prize key's own signatures; null

Adds campaign_45_affine_nonce.py, a read-only test of whether the 2020 halving signatures use a
nonce k = a*d + b from the neighbors/half/double vocabulary, which would let d fall out by
algebra. The self-test plants and recovers such a trapdoor and rejects normal signatures; the real
run against the three prize-key signatures finds no relation under any single-signature,
pairwise-nonce, repeated-nonce or point-identity branch. Records that the R.y idea has no on-chain
operand and that the relayed Apple Pie / Genesis scalars are not the Genesis address.
